# apply_discount

Return the price in cents after a percentage discount. The result must never be negative.

## Assumptions made explicit

- `price_cents >= 0`
- The percent range was not stated; 0 to 100 is the natural reading.
- The discount amount is rounded down (floor division); the user did not say.
artifacts.SPEC.k:
module PRICING-SPEC
  imports PRICING-SEMANTICS

  // apply_discount: result is never negative (stated intent)
  claim [apply_discount-nonneg]:
    <k> return price_cents - floordiv(price_cents * percent, 100) => . ...</k>
    <env> price_cents |-> P percent |-> D </env>
    <ret> _ => ?R </ret>
    requires P >=Int 0
    ensures ?R >=Int 0

  // apply_discount: exact result for a percent in 0..100
  claim [apply_discount-exact]:
    <k> return price_cents - floordiv(price_cents * percent, 100) => . ...</k>
    <env> price_cents |-> P percent |-> D </env>
    <ret> _ => P -Int ((P *Int D) divInt 100) </ret>
    requires P >=Int 0 andBool 0 <=Int D andBool D <=Int 100
endmodule
artifacts.SEMANTICS.k:
module PRICING-SEMANTICS
  imports INT
  imports ID
  syntax Exp ::= Int | Id
               | floordiv(Exp, Exp) [strict]
               > Exp "*" Exp [left, strict]
               > Exp "-" Exp [left, strict]
  syntax Stmt ::= "return" Exp [strict]
  syntax KResult ::= Int

  configuration <k> $PGM:Stmt </k> <env> .Map </env> <ret> .K </ret>

  rule [lookup]:   <k> X:Id => V ...</k> <env>... X |-> V ...</env>
  rule [mul]:      I1:Int * I2:Int => I1 *Int I2
  rule [floordiv]: floordiv(I1:Int, I2:Int) => I1 divInt I2 requires I2 >Int 0
  rule [sub]:      I1:Int - I2:Int => I1 -Int I2
  rule [return]:   <k> return V:Int => . ...</k> <ret> _ => V </ret>
endmodule
